segments.an10.116:1.1: Atha kho ajito paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.an10.116:1.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ajito paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an10.116:2.2: Tena pañcamattāni cittaṭṭhānasatāni cintitāni, yehi aññatitthiyā upāraddhāva jānanti [upāraddhā pajānanti (sī.)] upāraddhasmā”ti [upāraddhamhāti (sī. pī.)].
segments.an10.116:3.3: “Etassa, bhagavā, kālo etassa, sugata, kālo yaṃ bhagavā bhāseyya, bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī”ti.
segments.an10.116:4.1: “Tena hi, bhikkhave, suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.an10.116:4.2: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.an10.116:5.1: “Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco adhammikena vādena adhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti, tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti.
segments.an10.116:5.2: Tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddamahāsaddā hoti –
segments.an10.116:6.1: “Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco adhammikena vādena dhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti, tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti.
segments.an10.116:6.2: Tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddamahāsaddā hoti –
segments.an10.116:7.1: “Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco adhammikena vādena dhammikañca vādaṃ adhammikañca vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti, tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti.
segments.an10.116:7.2: Tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddamahāsaddā hoti –
segments.an10.116:8.3: Adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
segments.an10.116:9.1: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, adhammo, katamo ca dhammo, katamo ca anattho, katamo ca attho?
segments.an10.116:9.4: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho;
segments.an10.116:9.5: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
segments.an10.116:11.3: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho;
segments.an10.116:11.4: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
segments.an10.116:12.3: Adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabban’ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttan”ti.

lines: Upāraddhāva jānanti upāraddhasmāti viraddhā niggahitā evaṃ jānanti “viraddhā mayaṃ, niggahitā mayaṃ, āropito no doso”ti.
